scope: Read-only Blender source review; not Godot runtime acceptance.

pixel_review.body_gloves_collar_cape: No prior long upper-arm, lower-arm, glove, collar, or cape tether lines visible in grapple, strike, or crouch renders.
pixel_review.face_neck: Short neck creases and collar specks correspond to two measured skin-weight discontinuities, not ordinary compression.

internal_face_weight_discontinuity.cause: The jaw threshold branch assigns head plus jaw and excludes neck; its adjacent vertex takes the mutually exclusive head plus neck branch.

body_face_cut_ring.cause: The face cut ring is neck 1.0 while the lateral body cut ring includes the smooth shoulder field.

conclusion: The previous arm streak defect is fixed in the reviewed source poses. The remaining neck issue needs continuous head-neck-jaw weights and matched cut-ring weights; no geometry or neutral-art redesign is implicated.
